verdict.rationale: Teller's docs say the balances API returns live, real-time balances, and the marketing page promises guaranteed live balances for underwriting or pre-ACH checks. That implies a developer can get fresh balance data on demand just by calling the endpoint. However, the evidence shows no explicit refresh-trigger endpoint, and nothing says whether transactions or other account data are fetched live or cached. Missing for 10: an explicit on-demand refresh endpoint or mechanism, documented refresh semantics (latency, caching, rate limits, which resources refresh), freshness guarantees for transactions and other account data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
